products.title: HANCOCK
products.body_html: A rounder member of the aviator and navigator family, the Hancock's tear-dropped construction carries forward a shape with real pedigree, built to flatter across face structures for decades. Fixed with dual-plated hinges and GLCO’s original core wire, the details are rooted in old-world optical craftsmanship. Part aviator, part navigator - all charm. This is what happens when two classic lineages fall for each other.

products.title: WEDDINGTON
products.body_html: A lightweight, petite silhouette, the Weddington is drawn straight from the classic outlines and acetate styles of Old Hollywood glamour. Its shallow P3 shape (lens height 3mm less than lens width) creates a more perfectly circular lens, finished with a saddle bridge, signature hinge, and functional rivets in premium acetate. A small frame carrying a lot of history, still going strong.

products.title: VERDUGO
products.body_html: An evolution of one of our legacy frames, the Verdugo Sun brings clean lines and an easy, everyday thickness to a refined outline. Its classic, tapered GLCO temple is finished with our signature hinge, rivets, and core wire – heritage details built for daily wear. Equal parts throwback and update, it's the modern sun essential your rotation's been missing. 100% UV Protection.

products.title: HOLLENBECK
products.body_html: With a 54mm eye size and 150mm overall, Hollenbeck is the largest optical frame GLCO has ever made. Its strong, square shape and saddle bridge lets the frame sit higher and cover more face. Rounded out with extended temples and well-loved acetate colorways — Black Glass, Matte Brandy Tortoise, Willow. Consider it the eyewear equivalent of throwing on an oversized tee or wide-leg pants: deliberately, almost ironically, too much, and somehow exactly right.

products.title: KINNEY
products.body_html:
One of our Forever Classics, Kinney boasts a simple yet classic silhouette that's designed to suit everyone. Featuring a semi-square shape with balanced proportions and a keyhole bridge.

For instant shade, pair with the Kinney Clip.

products.title: HAMPTON
products.body_html:
The very first frame we ever designed, Hampton continues to be as relevant today as it was when it debuted in 2010. A classic P3 shape lends timeless appeal while contemporary acetates give it a modern edge.

For instant shade, pair with the Hampton Clip.

products.title: CLUBHOUSE II
products.body_html: Our classic metal style, Clubhouse, is updated with premium details for considered comfort and elevated style. The end pieces are finely engraved with a custom sun design and new acetate is added to the temple for comfort and weight distribution. The Gold colorway includes specialty bi-colored plating.

products.title: BENTLEY
products.body_html: Our bestselling oversized men's style, distinguished by the widest nose bridge in our collection. Bentley is tailored for wide faces and includes a saddle nose bridge for superior comfort and support.

products.title: HAMPTON X
products.body_html: As a nod to our beginnings, we redesigned the Hampton, our first and bestselling frame from our original collection. With a thicker acetate construction and glass lenses it's a bold, statement-making silhouette with a classic feel.

products.title: BOON
products.body_html:
The Boon is a traditional wide, rectangular style eyeglass with semi-rounded rims. These classic frames feature a thin acetate, keyhole bridge for considered comfort, and signature GLCO pins.

For instant shade, pair with the Boon Clip

products.title: ACE II
products.body_html: Our cult-favorite Ace Sun transformed into an optical. Ace II reflects the standard way in which we design and create premium eyewear. We’re not reinventing the wheel here – just putting some rims on ‘em.

products.title: CARROL
products.body_html: With its oversized retro silhouette, Carrol brings a classic vintage shape into modern times. A subtle upward slope at the end pieces creates the appearance of lift, infusing the design with a gentle femininity. Featuring a 5-barrel hinge and a saddle nose bridge.

products.title: GILBERT
products.body_html: Gilbert is a timeless silhouette inspired by the effortless style of the 50's. The slightly rounded square frame features a custom plaque and a new temple design for better comfort and weight distribution.

products.title: HERCULES
products.body_html: Hercules is a rounded frame with flared end pieces that nods to the signature frames worn by the artists of 60's and 70's. Comfort was carefully considered in the design of this frame, with a keyhole nose bridge and temple design to provide a better distribution of weight. The Hercules is finished with a Skyline plaque and features our custom GLCO Cube filigree corewire.

products.title: LANGLEY
products.body_html:
Langley is a large frame with medium thickness, merging retro and classic design elements with a modern twist. Equipped with an angular keyhole nose bridge detailing, two front vertical pins, and five-barrel hinges for enhanced durability and precision.

For instant shade, pair with the LANGLEY CLIP.

products.title: DOC
products.body_html: Doc combines a classic silhouette with easy to wear colorways. Its commanding double bridge and large frame stand out, finished with GLCO temple ball and pins for a distinctive touch.

products.title: ALBRIGHT
products.body_html: Albright is a timeless unisex frame defined by a balanced silhouette and classic detailing. Designed for everyday wear, it features GLCO’s signature dual-plated rivet hinges with polished pins and original core wire, resulting in a clean, enduring profile that transcends seasons.

products.title: LACHMAN
products.body_html: Lachman is a tailored unisex frame with a sculpted saddle bridge and subtle angular detailing along the top line. Clean-lined and versatile, it features GLCO’s signature dual-plated rivet hinges with polished pins and classic original core wire, bringing modern structure to a familiar silhouette.

products.title: EMBURY
products.body_html: Embury is a refined acetate frame with soft, tailored lines and a subtle saddle bridge. Rounded in classic GLCO construction, it features dual-plated rivet hinges with polished pins and original core wire, bringing quiet structure to a versatile, unisex silhouette.

products.title: MARIPOSA
products.body_html: Mariposa is an oversized hexagon frame with a bold, feminine silhouette that stands out with intention. Sculpted angles meet generous proportions, while GLCO’s dual-plated rivet hinges, polished pins, and classic core wire ground the design in signature craftsmanship. Confident, clean, and built to be noticed.

products.title: PARKMAN
products.body_html: Parkman is a classic large-frame silhouette with strong, masculine proportions. Designed with a structured temple and enduring shape, it features GLCO’s signature dual-plated rivet hinges with polished pins and original core wire, resulting in a bold yet timeless profile built for everyday wear.

products.title: CLUNE X
products.body_html: Clune X is our mid-century-inspired, ever-popular Clune frame reimagined. This P3 inspired frame presents a thicker acetate than its namesake featuring our classic GLCO corewire and double pins at the endpiece.

products.title: ALMA J
products.body_html: Alma J Soft is a soft half-rim optical hexagon frame. Crafted with brushed and antiqued metal plating for a subtly worn finish, the frame is finished with a woodgrain filigree temple and adjustable nose pads, creating a refined balance of structure and ease with a distinctly architectural profile.

products.title: WILSON M
products.body_html:
The refreshed metal version of our bestselling frame in mineral inspired acetates with a minimalist coin edge filigree and adjustable nose pads.

For instant shade, pair with the Wilson Clip.

products.title: LOMA
products.body_html: Loma is a vintage-inspired round frame with a compact silhouette and clean curvature. Featuring GLCO’s signature dual-plated rivet hinges with polished pins and original core wire, it’s finished with a tapered paddle temple that brings a subtle structural detail to this classically proportioned design.
